record.question: State whether the following statements are 'True' or 'False'. (g) A person who has purchased any land and to whom a certificate of purchase has been granted is not liable for the land revenue in respect of the land for any period prior to the date of the sale.
record.explanation: Section 73 of the Mizoram (Land Revenue) Act, 2013 says a certified purchaser is not liable for land revenue for any period before the sale date.

record.question: State whether the following statements are 'True' or 'False'. (j) Offences punishable under the Mizoram (Land Revenue) Act 2013 are neither cognizable nor punishable.

record.question: State whether the following statements are 'True' or 'False'. (f) Maximum dimension to be allotted for shop/stall is 15 square metres.
record.explanation: Rule 17(2) of the Mizoram (Land Revenue) Rules, 2013 specifies shop dimensions up to 30 m by 9.11 m and a stall area not exceeding 14 m², not a 15 m² maximum for both.

record.question: State whether the following statements are 'True' or 'False'. (b) When a plot of land is allotted to a person, in order to obtain Land Settlement Certificate for the plot, a house shall be constructed within a period of 5(five) years.
